Expertise spans Power BI (Advanced DAX, Power Query/M, SSRS, Paginated Reports), SQL (CTEs, stored procedures, query optimization), data modeling (Star Schema, semantic models, RLS), BI solution architecture, enterprise analytics and client-facing delivery across Agile/Scrum with Jira and Azure DevOps CI/CD. Open to Senior and Lead Power BI / BI opportunities across India (Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai & other major metros) and GCC (Dubai & UAE main cities, Saudi Arabia main cities, Qatar).
